title: Telepathic friend meets an unvoiced telepath

tellings.quote: one of the my friends who's telepathic recently had a contact with an unvoiced person

plain: A telepathic person recently made contact with someone who does not speak aloud, an "unvoiced person" who communicates only by thought. The writer Whitley Strieber tells Michels this about a friend of his, as something the friend told him. If true, it would mean such silent people are living among us.
